name_vi: Rổ bày salad có lòng thủy tinh
description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: An open rounded woven cradle holds one empty transparent glass salad bowl. Side: The glass lip extends above the woven rim and isolates food from fibers. Rear: The rear weave wraps uninterrupted around the bowl above a solid foot ring. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
